dedupe_keys.name: hourly anomaly scores and leak labels from a slovak urban water distribution network 2022

description: This dataset gives one year of hourly data from one water distribution zone of a Slovak water utility, built to benchmark anomaly-based leak detection, and is described in a Scientific Data descriptor. SCADA flow and pressure, energy use in kilowatts and kilovolt-ampere reactive, and environmental indicators such as groundwater level, temperature and humidity were turned into anomaly scores from 0 to 100 with Elastic Machine Learning and Isolation Forest, and confirmed leaks from the utility's information system were mapped to a binary label within seven days. Coverage is one urban zone in Slovakia, 31 December 2021 to 30 December 2022. The data are a free download from Zenodo under CC BY 4.0: one CSV of 8,737 rows with 18 variables, and a README. Caveats: the file holds anomaly scores, not raw sensor values, missing readings are left empty, and no code is deposited. Simulation uses: training and testing leak detection and early-warning methods for water network digital twins. Related records: BattLeDIM (data-battledim-leakage-detection-benchmark) and LeakDB (data-leakdb).
name: Hourly anomaly scores and leak labels from a Slovak urban water distribution network (2022)
provider: Authors of the Scientific Data descriptor (Zenodo deposit)
